title: Lead Training Coordinator
description:
anthem is seeking a Lead Training Coordinator who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Lead Training Coordinator, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our general capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute general initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 6+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Communication, Stakeholder Management, Team Management, Project Management
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €140,000 – €220,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

Salesforce is seeking a Principal Database Administrator who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Principal Database Administrator, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 8+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Stakeholder Management, Microservices, Microsoft Office, Kubernetes
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €320,000 – €450,000
- Hybrid work options available

- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours
